g.text: Multi-path canvas: from one graph to parallel jobs

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(234, 242, 255), rgb(23, 30, 41)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

g.text: Run All Experiments (toolbar), or
Train model / Tune model on one node

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Server checks the graph for leakage
(POST /api/pipeline/run)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(253, 236, 236), rgb(42, 28, 28)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

g.text: Rejected with HTTP 400;
no job is created

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Split into branches
canvas parts that are not connected become
separate groups; each model node is a branch.
A model node with 2+ inputs follows its toggle:

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Train / Tune on one node:
only the branches that
contain that node are kept

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Merge (default)
one branch; when it runs, the node
combines the data from all its inputs

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Parallel
one branch per input path, each with its
own copy of the shared upstream nodes

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: One queued job per branch
a branch that is already queued or running
returns its existing job instead of a new one

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 233, 199), rgb(52, 33, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: New jobs run at the same time
one Celery task, or threads in-process

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 244, 229), rgb(34, 25, 12)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

g.text: Inside a job: a node with 2+ inputs merges them
same row count: columns side by side; a column changed
by only one input keeps that change, other ties go to
the last input (or the first, if chosen)
different row counts: rows stacked on shared columns,
an error if no column is shared
train, validation and test are merged separately
Results
the Experiments view compares the branches;
the Jobs drawer lists every submitted job
